name: Nicnevin
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nicnevin is a figure of Scottish folklore. In some sources this name belongs to the figure also called Habetrot. Habetrot is a beautiful fairy queen. In her malevolent guise she leads the Wild Hunt. This hunt steals people from their homes. The stolen people are made to entertain the fairies.
